# Broken Arrow Deck Manager v1.0.4

## Changes

- Added a confirmation prompt when creating a backup with a name that already exists.
- Choosing `No` cancels the backup and keeps the existing saved set unchanged.
- Choosing `Yes` overwrites the existing saved set with the current active decks.
- Added overwrite-confirmation strings for all shipped UI languages.
- Updated README and restore notes with the overwrite behavior.

## Maintenance

- Updated GitHub Actions workflow actions to Node 24-compatible major versions ahead of GitHub's Node 20 runner deprecation.

## Verification

- Python source compiles successfully.
- All locale JSON files parse successfully.
- Packaged Windows app rebuilds successfully with PyInstaller.
